[b][u]Nordiheim News.[/u][/b]

The modern, and well known, news room of Nordiheim news comes up on the screen, but unlike earlier news casts there is no longer only one person behind the large glass desk, bot Jarli and Asha now sits behind it since the emergensy lock-down have been lifted or lessened in many areas of Nordiheim.

They both greet the camera/viewers before Jarli starts with the first piece of news.
[i]Today we have several news for you loyal viewers with the first part pertaining to the recent official event of the Republic of Datia joining Nordiheim as our fellow brothers and sisters after long and thorough bureaucratic and integration effort.
While there are still some work left to do such as finishing the last railroads to smaller cities, balancing the propperty and housing prices and of course the slow prosses of restoring a more propper balance in the lands biological and nutritional earth healt, it is going forward slowly but steadily.[/i]

Asha now takes over as if a unseen signal have been given.
[i]The department of economic affairs have also declared that a new local company called "Datia Mining" have been created to start creating sites for mines to access the large deposits of Nickel-Coboltite that was discovered in the land between Mparntwe and Malanda, it is planed for this ore to be transported to the industrial area of the capitol Midgard were metallurgical refinerys are going to be constructed, wich is planed to start soon.[/i]
Jarli takes over agein with with well trained cordination.
[i]While the ore contains many trace ellements it is going to be mainly the Nickel, Cobolt, Sulfure, Silver and Platinum Group Metals that will the main resources extracted from it for use in Nordiheims industry or potential future trade, tough it will proberly be some time before this operation gets propperly up and running.[/i]

Jarli looks over at Asha as she takes over and starts talking about the next piece of interesting news with the background screen showing the flags of Nordiheim and Oceanice Republics with a trade symbol between them.
[i]Regarding the matter of trade, the diplomatic team that was sendt to the [nation]Oceanice Republics[/nation] to hopefully start up trade between our two nations again, as the old trade deal fell appart after their old goverement was overthrown, have reported some progress though nothing is yet sett in stone.
The diplomatic team is led by diplomat Æsir af Tyrsblood who have prior experience in negotiating with the people of the Oceanice Republic from past deals with them.[/i]

Jarli takes over the talking at this point.
[i]Lets hope they are succesful so we see their fancy luxury goods ones more.[/i]
He says with a slight smile before leaning slightly forward and continues with someting new, with the screen behind them switching to the now slightly familiar jet fighter exept that there is two of it.
[i]The mysterious aircraft that have been given the name 'Black Swan' have been observed to not only be flying more often but also seems to have gotten itself a new friend as there is reports of it flying together with an identical twin, experts that we have talked with says that this indicates that the military is most likely getting close to potentialy finishing it and they might soon publicly anouncing its creation together with its full name.[/i]
He turns towards Asha with a grinn.
[i]Perhaps Nordiheim can finnaly creat a powerfull airforce again like we had back in the 50s and 60s.[/i]
Looking slightly over at Jarli she replies.
[i]Thats not impossible, and would be wonderfull news, since the airforce have been a bit disepointing the last decades.[/i]
Asha look back fully at the screen.
[i]Another possible piece of military news is the possibility of another navy test in the Olian islands region for the new direct energy system, as there is reports of a sea zone being closed off for somting that the Olain navy are going to conduct, though at this point it is also possible that it is joust a general exercise, we will of course report on it when we know more.[/i]

The two then both looks at the screen with a smile as the background screen goes back to joust showing the news channels logo.
[i]That is all we have for today, this have been your daily Nodiheim News with me Asha[/i]
[i]And me the handsome Jarli[/i]
Then together they both say;
[i]Signing out untill next time![/i]

[nation]Tartakum[/nation]
Seeing as you are a neighbor of a close ally of mine, Hydronia, I would like to propose a few things. Due to your strategic location near shipping lanes as well as gold reserves, we are willing to provide a few things.

[b][u]Tartakum-ULR Friendship and Mining Deal Draft[/u][/b]

[b]Diplomacy & Trade[/b]
1.a: Both nations will establish embassies with each other, allowing for diplomatic staff to live in the radius of such embassies with special visas.
1.b: Buildings or plots of land for these embassies will be provided by each state.
1.c: Tartakum will be allowed into the EEHP as an observer, granting a path to future membership.
1.d: The ULR will put in a good word for Tartakum in application for the THEP partnership program.
1.e: Tartakum will allow Lavian ships to dock, resupply, and even hire crew in their ports.
1.f: Lavia will be allowed to purchase from the Tartakan market, providing a flow of money from exports.

[b]Mining[/b]
2.a: The Tartakan government will partner with Lavian mining firms to extract gold from their northeastern land.
2.b: Lavian mining firms will train Tartakan workers in operation of machinery, vehicles, and processing equipment.
2.c: Lavian mining firms will provide most equipment used and hire local workers, helping improve the local economy.
2.d: A profit split of 70:30 between the Lavian firms and the Tartakan government, improving the Tartakan budget.

[b]Military[/b]
3.a: Lavian military experts will help train Tartakan recruits and improve tactics.
3.b: The Tartakan military will be supplied with 150 MAVH-15 LPAPCs and 50 MAVH-15 LCFVs to improve their armored capabilities.
3.c: The Tartakan airforce will be allowed to purchase 10 units of the Manzatron Soldier Ant for a price of $8m, with the Lavian govenment paying the rest of the cost for the aircraft.
3.d: Lavian military exports such as the purchasing of equipment, ammunition, spare arts, and training of use and maintenance on such equipment will remain open to Tartakum for the foreseeable future, only being closed off if one nation violates the terms of this agreement.
3.e: The Tartakan and Lavian militaries will be able to participate in joint exercises, improving readiness of both nations.
